people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.
translations.bsb: And there was no king in Edom; a deputy served as king.
translations.kjv: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
translations.asv: And there was no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
